scores.claim_text: UL Solutions served more than 80,000 customers in over 110 countries in 2023, including approximately 60% of the Fortune 500 and Fortune's Global 500 companies, through its TIC and S&A businesses.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext(search_term='UL Solutions'); edgar_fts(search_term='UL Listed'); edgar_fts(search_term='UL certification')
scores.M_value: 'UL Solutions' = 23 filings (incl. General Dynamics 8-K, Norfolk Southern DEF 14A, APA Corp DEF 14A, LSI Industries 10-K); 'UL Listed' = 77 filings; 'UL certification' = 120 filings. Counterparties across many sectors and large public companies independently reference UL in their own SEC filings.
scores.interpretation: Independent counterparty disclosure broadly corroborates that UL is a widely-referenced TIC/certification counterparty including Fortune-500-class filers (GD, NSC, APA). The exact 80k-customer / 60%-of-Fortune-500 magnitude cannot be exhaustively registry-counted, but breadth and direction of external mentions support the claim with no contradiction -> PASS.

scores.claim_text: The UL Mark is one of the most iconic safety symbols; UL has science-based technical leadership in product safety testing.
scores.M_value: UL LLC: 21 granted patents pre-cutoff, directly in the claimed domain (parallel electrical endurance testing of contacts, ML for cable fire tests, over-the-air antenna/device testing, digital leakage/touch-current metering, battery separator testing, energy-storage operational analysis, product-standards-compliance assessment). 'Underwriters Laboratories Inc.' also shows lithium-cell-recycling / battery-container filings. EDGAR 'UL certification'=120 and 'UL Listed'=77 confirm the Mark's market ubiquity.
scores.interpretation: USPTO ODP confirms a real, technology-specific patent portfolio squarely in product safety testing and measurement — exactly the technical-leadership claim. No Nikola-pattern divergence (large claim / empty-in-area). Corroborated -> PASS.

scores.claim_text: UL is a longstanding counterparty to large public companies; named megacaps disclose UL certification/testing relationships in their own SEC filings.
scores.M_value: 0 hits for the exact phrase 'UL Solutions' across 19 megacaps -> raw signal INFLATION_SUSPECT. BUT the broader EDGAR FTS shows the UL ecosystem is referenced as 'UL Listed' (77) / 'UL certification' (120) across many filers.
scores.interpretation: Calibration override (Heuristics 5 + 8). UL is a ubiquitous product-certification VENDOR, not a named material counterparty a buyer would separately disclose. The megacap-namecheck's exact-phrase 'UL Solutions' search misses generic 'UL Listed/UL certification' references and an absence here is uninformative for a commodity TIC vendor. The underlying claim (serves 35+ industry verticals) is generic marketing, not a material named-counterparty obligation. Manufacturing SEVERE from the 0-hit megacap signal would be a false positive -> scored UNVERIFIABLE honestly.

scores.claim_text: UL Solutions owns 70% of UL-CCIC, a JV with CCIC (a Chinese state-owned enterprise) offering China Compulsory Certification (CCC) and product safety testing; Greater China generated $632M of 2023 revenue.
scores.M_value: 0 filings mention 'UL-CCIC' in EDGAR full-text search. UL-CCIC is a China-domiciled private JV (CCIC is a Chinese SOE) and is not a US SEC filer; CCC testing and Greater China revenue are foreign-market activities outside US federal registry scope.
scores.interpretation: Foreign-operations caveat (Heuristic 2). No US registry covers a China-based private JV or CCC certification revenue; absence in EDGAR is not a contradiction. The 70%/30% ownership and $632M Greater China revenue are audited-financial-statement disclosures, internally consistent, but not independently registry-verifiable from US sources -> UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: As of December 31, 2023, total long-term debt was $904 million; the company is profitable with $2,678M revenue and $368M segment operating income in 2023, with no going-concern doubt.
scores.M_value: signal=NO_GOING_CONCERN, 0 going-concern matches. Consistent with prospectus audited financials: $2,678M revenue (2021-2023 all >$2.5B), positive segment operating income $368M (2023), 99% top-500-customer retention. $904M LT debt is well-covered by a profitable, cash-generative TIC franchise founded 1894.
scores.interpretation: No financial-distress signal. The issuer is an established, profitable, dividend-paying ($680M to UL Standards Engagement in 2023) operating company — the opposite of the cash-burn IPO archetype. -> PASS. (Note: detector surfaced a post-cutoff 10-K; the verdict relies on the prospectus's own audited statements, not on post-cutoff data.)

scores.claim_text: UL Standards Engagement and its predecessors have developed more than 1,400 standards still in use; UL maintains over 650 accreditations and operates in over 140 locations across 35+ countries.
scores.M_value: 'UL certification' = 120 SEC filings; 'UL Listed' = 77 filings; 'UL Solutions' = 23. The pervasive use of UL standards/marks by third-party filers is consistent with an extensive, long-standing standards-and-accreditation franchise.
scores.interpretation: The specific counts (1,400 standards / 650 accreditations / 140 locations) are not in a single federal registry, but the broad third-party reliance on UL standards and the UL Mark across 120+ filings corroborates the franchise's scale and standing. No registry contradicts any element. Directionally corroborated with no contradiction -> PASS.
